g.text: Agreement: ● raw, ◇ composition residuals. Gains: ◆ assignment mean, × pinned; line = min–max.
Geometry: 981 rows · retrieval: 291 test rows · gains: 10 matched fold assignments
Residualization fits all rows before retrieval evaluation. Gain ranges are not confidence intervals.
Gains use raw embeddings and subtract the better single encoder within each assignment. Retrieval: RNA → protein.
